title: Paper napkins, parent rolls made in Indonesia, converted in China
description: Tissue parent rolls are made in Indonesia, then embossed, cut, folded and packaged in China. CBP held Indonesia (N341898): the parent roll decides.
notes: One of the six families added in D660 (paper, tissue and paperboard products). Built from the ruling's facts into a development fixture: the target plant's capabilities, duty rates, import value and group costs are illustrative placeholders, not sourced. The ruling itself is excluded from precedent search. Picked by family, not by result. Recorded development run (eval/results/plan-paper-napkins-2024-local-verifier-v2-d660-litellm.json): the engine agreed with CBP on Indonesia at 0.95 stated; the plan to move parent-roll production to China was shown at 0.98 on N340077. N340077 held Indonesia for napkins converted from Indonesian parent rolls, so it supports the parent roll deciding; it is a different ruling from the one excluded here. A run on this site is a new run and may differ.
